label: Palazzo Vecchio
summary: Seat of the Florentine government; its Sala del Gran Consiglio (today Salone dei Cinquecento) was the site of the Battle of Anghiari commission (w-anghiari), and the Chapel of San Bernardo commission of 1478 (e-chapel) was for the same palace.
